Author: SuperBXO-O
Name: INPA Bridge
Punchline: Connects INPA Front Desk Helper with the game: target selection, private chat, embedded pages, inventory, and automated trading
Description: Serves the Front Desk Helper web app from local port 127.0.0.1:18500 to the in-game browser and provides target selection (name@world), chat delivery, inventory access, automated item and gil trading, and trade event reporting. Actions run only when initiated from the web app; the plugin does not operate in the background.
